task.title: To unlock or lock Read-Only clauses

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and launch the add-in.
Log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
In the Contracts pane, go to Start tab, search and open a generated agreement document containing read-only clauses.
Go to Work tab > Unlock Clauses. All the read-only clauses in the agreement document become editable.

info.p: If there are no read-only clauses in the agreement document and you select Unlock Clauses, an error message is displayed.

step.cmd: Make the required changes to the read-only clauses or delete read-only clauses.

info.p: To delete a read-only clause, see making clauses delete read-only.

step.cmd: Go to Work tab > Lock Clauses.

info.p: The read-only clauses cannot be modified. You cannot undo changes after the read-only clauses are locked.
If you do not lock read-only clauses and check in the agreement document, the read-only clauses get locked automatically.

note.p: You can view modified unlocked read-only clauses on the Reconciliation page or Agreement Clauses tab.
